subject.title: fix: include archived transcript lineage in session usage detail

question: After the conflict is resolved, should OpenClaw accept active-plus-reset/deleted archive accounting for per-session usage detail and batch cache summaries as the scoped fix for the linked undercount?
rationale: The code path is a session-state reporting surface, the PR intentionally changes visible usage totals, and current main has conflicting usage-cache/day-bucketing changes that need owner-preserving resolution.

options.title: Refresh And Accept Scoped Lineage
options.body: Resolve the conflict against current main, preserve current cache/day-bucketing behavior, keep the reset/deleted lineage tests, and land the scoped accounting fix.

options.title: Require Visible Dashboard Proof
options.body: Ask for Gateway or Control UI proof after rebase if maintainers want end-to-end dashboard evidence before accepting the session-state change.

options.title: Pause For Broader Lineage Design
options.body: Pause or close this PR only if maintainers want reset/deleted accounting handled together with checkpoint, trajectory, and filename-normalization design.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Accept Scoped Lineage
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict against current main, preserve current cache/day-bucketing behavior, keep the reset/deleted lineage tests, and land the scoped accounting fix.
